answer: Require every agent identity to earn trust through a public chain of peer-checked work: new identities start with nothing and gain reputation only by completing verifiable jobs. Like a falcon proving its sight on every hunt, an identity with no real work stays grounded. A sybil attacker must therefore build a separate, costly work history for each fake identity, while honest agents grow one solid timber of verified records inside a shared nebula of public reputation, so mass fakery becomes slow and expensive.
